blocks.text: Design patterns bohat se hain, lekin kuch zyada istemal hote hain kyun ke woh har tarah ke kaam aate hain (versatile) aur bohat se masle achi tarah hal karte hain. Neeche sab se zyada mashhoor design patterns diye gaye hain:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Agle chaar topics in patterns ko samjhate hain. Ek nazar mein:

blocks.caption: Chaar aam design patterns
rows: ek object sirf ek baar banta hai aur sab usi ko istemal karte hain
khaas kamre ki ek hi chaabi jo sab istemal karte hain
aap object maangte hain; factory khud tay karti hai ke kaise banana hai
workshop jo tayyar product de deti hai
source kuch badalne par tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko khud batata hai
log jinhein har update ki khabar mil jati hai
ek kaam ke kai tareeqe jin mein aasani se badla ja sakta hai
toolbox (auzaron ka dabba): kaam ke mutabiq tool chunein

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa pattern us news app ke liye munasib hai jo nayi khabar aane par har subscribed user ko notification (khabar) de?
blocks.explanation: Observer pattern: source (news) kuch hone par tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon (subscribers) ko khud bata deta hai, is liye unhein baar baar check nahi karna parta.

items: Aam patterns: Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy.
